children.game_version: Focus on 'statue' isolations (moving only one body part at a time) to pop music.

seniors.counts: Standard 4/4 counts, focusing on one movement per two beats.
seniors.seated_version: Perform torso and arm isolations while seated in a stable chair; wear flat, supportive shoes instead of heels.
seniors.standing_version: Use a ballet barre or sturdy chair for balance; perform footwork in flat shoes or low, wide heels.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduce tempo by 50%; limit the range of torso movements to avoid strain.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Fluid and expressive, drawing from exotic and contemporary dance styles.
movement_profile.footwork: Dynamic steps based on jazz and ballroom; requires constant awareness of the heel's placement.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Solo performance; utilizes both vertical space and floor levels.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Heavy use of isolations borrowed from belly dance and hip-hop.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Frequent level changes from standing to floor; jumps are rare due to heel stability risks.
movement_profile.posture: Upright with an engaged core to manage the forward shift in center of gravity caused by heels.

signature_moves.description: Independent movement of the chest or hips while the rest of the body remains still.
signature_moves.name: Torso Isolation

signature_moves.description: Athletic movements performed on the ground, transitioning from standing to floor and back.
signature_moves.name: Floor work

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Sharp and punctuated during isolations; fluid during transitions.
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid locking knees; avoid placing full weight on the heel during rapid lateral movements to prevent ankle injury.

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Strong backbeat with electronic or synthesized percussion typical of pop and hip-hop.
music_profile.sound_description: The sound is defined by modern commercial production, featuring heavy basslines and sharp percussive elements that facilitate the 'hits' and isolations in the choreography.

teaching.level_notes: Requires prior experience in balance and core stability due to the footwear.
teaching.rhythm: Syncopated and beat-driven, following pop or hip-hop structures
